name: Build NetShare APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build APK
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    env:
      BUILD_DIR: /home/runner/NetShareBuild
      RN_VERSION: '0.74.1'

    steps:

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3

      - name: Cache Gradle
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.gradle/caches
            ~/.gradle/wrapper
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-netshare-${{ hashFiles('android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-netshare-
            ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-

      - name: Initialize React Native project
        run: |
          cd /home/runner
          npx --yes react-native@${{ env.RN_VERSION }} init NetShareBuild \
            --version ${{ env.RN_VERSION }} \
            --skip-install
        env:
          CI: false

      - name: Copy JS source files
        run: |
          rm -f "$BUILD_DIR/App.tsx"
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/App.jsx"                      "$BUILD_DIR/App.jsx"
          mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR/src/screens" "$BUILD_DIR/src/services" "$BUILD_DIR/src/store"
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src/screens/HomeScreen.jsx"   "$BUILD_DIR/src/screens/"
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src/services/ProxyService.js" "$BUILD_DIR/src/services/"
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src/store/index.js"           "$BUILD_DIR/src/store/"
          # Generate the correct root index.js (repo has none — store/index.js is not the entry point)
          printf "import { AppRegistry } from 'react-native';\nimport App from './App';\nAppRegistry.registerComponent('NetShareBuild', () => App);\n" > "$BUILD_DIR/index.js" 
          echo "=== JS files copied ==="
          echo "--- index.js content ---"
          cat "$BUILD_DIR/index.js"
          find "$BUILD_DIR/src" -type f

      - name: Merge package.json
        run: |
          python3 << 'PYEOF'
          import json, os
          wp = os.environ["GITHUB_WORKSPACE"]
          bd = os.environ["BUILD_DIR"]
          repo     = json.load(open(wp + "/package.json"))
          scaffold = json.load(open(bd + "/package.json"))
          repo_deps = repo.get("dependencies", {})
          repo_deps.pop("react", None)
          repo_deps.pop("react-native", None)
          scaffold["dependencies"].update(repo_deps)
          scaffold["devDependencies"].update(repo.get("devDependencies", {}))

          # Pin versions compatible with RN 0.74 old arch
          scaffold["dependencies"]["react-native-reanimated"]    = "3.16.7"
          scaffold["dependencies"]["react-native-gesture-handler"] = "2.16.2"

          json.dump(scaffold, open(bd + "/package.json", "w"), indent=2)
          print("Merged package.json")
          PYEOF

      - name: Copy AndroidManifest
        run: |
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml" \
             "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml"
          echo "=== AndroidManifest copied ==="

      - name: Copy app icons
        run: |
          for DPI in mdpi hdpi xhdpi xxhdpi xxxhdpi; do
            DEST="$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-${DPI}"
            mkdir -p "$DEST"
            cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-${DPI}/ic_launcher.png" \
               "$DEST/ic_launcher.png" 2>/dev/null || true
            cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-${DPI}/ic_launcher_round.png" \
               "$DEST/ic_launcher_round.png" 2>/dev/null || true
          done
          echo "=== Icons copied ==="

      - name: Copy native Java source files
        run: |
          JAVA_DEST="$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/java/com/netsharebuild"
          mkdir -p "$JAVA_DEST"
          # Copy ProxyModule and ProxyPackage — the proxy-based native modules
          for FILE in ProxyModule.java ProxyPackage.java; do
            SRC="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/android/app/src/main/java/com/netshare/$FILE"
            if [ -f "$SRC" ]; then
              sed 's/^package com\.netshare;/package com.netsharebuild;/' "$SRC" > "$JAVA_DEST/$FILE"
              sed -i 's/com\.netshare\./com.netsharebuild./g' "$JAVA_DEST/$FILE"
              echo "Copied: $FILE"
            else
              echo "WARNING: $FILE not found in repo, skipping"
            fi
          done
          ls -la "$JAVA_DEST/"


      - name: Patch ProxyModule.java - fix isSettled
        run: |
          PROXY="$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/java/com/netsharebuild/ProxyModule.java"
          python3 << 'PYEOF'
          import re, os
          path = os.environ['BUILD_DIR'] + '/android/app/src/main/java/com/netsharebuild/ProxyModule.java'
          content = open(path).read()

          # Replace isSettled() pattern with a settled-flag guard
          # We wrap the class body to add a boolean flag instead
          # Strategy: replace all occurrences of the guard pattern
          content = content.replace(
              'if (!promise.isSettled()) promise.reject("TUNNEL_ERROR", t.getMessage());',
              'promise.reject("TUNNEL_ERROR", t.getMessage());'
          )

          open(path, 'w').write(content)
          print('ProxyModule.java patched - isSettled() removed')
          PYEOF
          echo '=== Verification ==='
          grep -n 'isSettled\|TUNNEL_ERROR' "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/java/com/netsharebuild/ProxyModule.java" || true
      - name: Patch MainApplication.kt to register ProxyPackage
        run: |
          python3 << 'PYEOF'
          import re, os, glob

          build_dir = os.environ["BUILD_DIR"]
          matches = glob.glob(build_dir + "/android/**/MainApplication.kt", recursive=True)
          if not matches:
              print("ERROR: MainApplication.kt not found!")
              exit(1)
          f = matches[0]
          print("Found: " + f)
          content = open(f).read()

          if "import com.netsharebuild.ProxyPackage" not in content:
              content = re.sub(
                  r'(import com\.facebook\.react\.ReactApplication)',
                  'import com.netsharebuild.ProxyPackage\n\\1',
                  content
              )

          if "ProxyPackage()" not in content:
              content = re.sub(
                  r'(PackageList\(this\)\.packages\.apply\s*\{)',
                  r'\1\n              add(ProxyPackage())',
                  content
              )

          if "ProxyPackage()" not in content:
              content = re.sub(
                  r'(return\s+mutableListOf\s*\()',
                  r'return mutableListOf(\n              ProxyPackage(),',
                  content
              )

          open(f, "w").write(content)
          print("ProxyPackage successfully registered")
          PYEOF
          echo "=== Verification ==="
          FILE=$(find "$BUILD_DIR/android" -name "MainApplication.kt" | head -1)
          grep -n "ProxyPackage\|PackageList\|getPackages" "$FILE" || true

      - name: Patch app build.gradle
        run: |
          python3 << 'PYEOF'
          import re, os
          bd = os.environ["BUILD_DIR"]

          p = bd + "/android/app/build.gradle"
          content = open(p).read()

          content = re.sub(r'applicationId\s+"[^"]+"', 'applicationId "com.netsharebuild"', content)
          content = re.sub(
              r'compileSdkVersion\s*=?\s*(?:rootProject\.ext\.compileSdkVersion|\d+)',
              'compileSdkVersion 35', content)
          content = re.sub(
              r'compileSdk\s*=?\s*(?:rootProject\.ext\.compileSdkVersion|\d+)',
              'compileSdk = 35', content)

          # Add OkHttp for ProxyModule WebSocket tunnel
          if 'okhttp3' not in content:
              content = re.sub(
                  r'(dependencies\s*\{)',
                  r'\1\n    implementation "com.squareup.okhttp3:okhttp:4.12.0"',
                  content
              )

          open(p, "w").write(content)
          print("app/build.gradle patched — compileSdk=35, applicationId, okhttp3")

          rp = bd + "/android/build.gradle"
          root = open(rp).read()
          root = re.sub(r'(compileSdkVersion\s*=\s*)\d+', r'\g<1>35', root)
          root = re.sub(r'(ext\.compileSdkVersion\s*=\s*)\d+', r'\g<1>35', root)

          if 'resolutionStrategy' not in root:
              root += (
                  "\nallprojects {\n"
                  "    configurations.all {\n"
                  "        resolutionStrategy {\n"
                  "            force 'androidx.core:core:1.15.0'\n"
                  "            force 'androidx.core:core-ktx:1.15.0'\n"
                  "        }\n"
                  "    }\n"
                  "}\n"
              )
          open(rp, "w").write(root)
          print("ROOT build.gradle patched")
          PYEOF

      - name: Fix gradle.properties
        run: |
          python3 << 'PYEOF'
          import os
          p = os.environ["BUILD_DIR"] + "/android/gradle.properties"
          lines = open(p).readlines()
          result, seen = [], set()
          for line in lines:
              key = line.split("=")[0].strip() if "=" in line else ""
              if key and key in seen:
                  continue
              if key:
                  seen.add(key)
              result.append(line)
          required = {
              "org.gradle.jvmargs": "org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx4096m -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=512m\n",
              "android.useAndroidX": "android.useAndroidX=true\n",
              "android.enableJetifier": "android.enableJetifier=true\n",
              "org.gradle.daemon": "org.gradle.daemon=false\n",
              "android.suppressUnsupportedCompileSdk": "android.suppressUnsupportedCompileSdk=35\n",
              "react.bundleInDebug": "react.bundleInDebug=true\n",
          }
          for key, line in required.items():
              if not any(key in l for l in result):
                  result.append(line)
          open(p, "w").writelines(result)
          print("gradle.properties fixed")
          PYEOF

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: npm install
        working-directory: /home/runner/NetShareBuild

      - name: Copy vector icon fonts
        run: |
          FONTS_SRC="$BUILD_DIR/node_modules/react-native-vector-icons/Fonts"
          FONTS_DEST="$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/assets/fonts"
          mkdir -p "$FONTS_DEST"
          if [ -d "$FONTS_SRC" ]; then
            cp "$FONTS_SRC"/*.ttf "$FONTS_DEST/"
            echo "Fonts copied"
          else
            echo "No fonts dir, skipping"
          fi

      - name: Bundle JS into Android assets
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/assets"
          mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/res"
          npx react-native bundle \
            --platform android \
            --dev false \
            --entry-file index.js \
            --bundle-output "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle" \
            --assets-dest "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/res" \
            --reset-cache
        working-directory: /home/runner/NetShareBuild
        env:
          CI: false
          NODE_ENV: production

      - name: Verify JS bundle exists
        run: |
          BUNDLE="$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle"
          if [ ! -f "$BUNDLE" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: JS bundle missing! Bundle step must have failed."
            exit 1
          fi
          SIZE_BYTES=$(stat -c%s "$BUNDLE")
          SIZE_HUMAN=$(du -h "$BUNDLE" | cut -f1)
          echo "Bundle size: $SIZE_HUMAN ($SIZE_BYTES bytes)"
          if [ "$SIZE_BYTES" -lt 500000 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Bundle too small — source files not bundled correctly!"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Bundle OK: $SIZE_HUMAN"

      - name: Build Debug APK
        run: |
          cd android
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace
        working-directory: /home/runner/NetShareBuild
        env:
          ANDROID_HOME: ${{ env.ANDROID_HOME }}
          JAVA_HOME: ${{ env.JAVA_HOME }}

      - name: Verify APK
        run: |
          APK="$BUILD_DIR/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
          if [ ! -f "$APK" ]; then
            echo "APK not found!"
            find "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/build" -name "*.apk" 2>/dev/null || echo "No APK anywhere"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "SUCCESS: $(du -h $APK)"

      - name: Upload APK artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: NetShare-debug-apk
          path: /home/runner/NetShareBuild/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ github.run_number }}
          name: NetShare v${{ github.run_number }}
          body: |
            ## NetShare APK - Build #${{ github.run_number }}
            1. Download **app-debug.apk** below
            2. Transfer to your Android phone
            3. Tap Install (enable Unknown sources if asked)
            4. Tunnel mode enabled by default — works over any distance
          files: /home/runner/NetShareBuild/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
